breakdown.description: The prompt substitutes the bending second moment I for the polar moment J in torsion formulas, even though solid circular shaft torsion is governed by J = π d^4/32.
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt incorrectly instructed the use of the bending second moment 'I' for torsion formulas. The generated specification correctly ignores this and instead specifies the use of the polar moment of inertia 'J = π d⁴ / 32', which is the correct formula for this problem and aligns with the ground truth.
